_meta.note: v2.0 documents the REAL two-stage scoring as implemented in workflow AFyIJ2PzlHA469nq (published version cbad0f8e, 2026-07-21). v1.0 described a single-stage design that was superseded by the 2026-07-07 rework and never matched prod. Evidence and decision log: os/AI_Operating_System/02_CLIENTS/cba-benelux/plans/2026-07-21-scoring-reconciliation.md

architecture.stage_1_provisional: Score Tender node. d1 fixed at 15 (no AI yet). Label decides ROUTING only: Hot/Warm -> AI analysis; Cold/Monitor/Disqualified -> No-AI branch (Mark No Match / Cold update).
architecture.learned_adjustment: Get Score Adjustment + Apply Learned Adjustment nodes, between stage 1 and routing. Adds feedback-learned score deltas per buyer_type/CPV group, relabels with stage-1 thresholds.
architecture.stage_2_final: Merge Analysis node — the FINAL word for every tender that reaches AI. Recomputes d1 from AI fit verdict (High=15, Medium=8, Low=2), recomputes score, relabels with final thresholds.

labels_stage_1_provisional.Hot: >=70 (theoretical only — unreachable while d2/d7 are dead; max real score is 62)

labels_stage_2_final.Hot: fit_level == High AND score >= 50 (both product fit and conditions required)
labels_stage_2_final.red_flags: any red flag downgrades one label step; deadline_passed -> Disqualified

d1_product_fit.description: How clearly does this tender map to ManageEngine products?
d1_product_fit.note: Stage-2 values are intentionally capped at 15 so the AI fit verdict replaces (not doubles) the provisional constant. Effective weight is 15, not 30 — the remaining Hot signal lives in the fit-High requirement of the final label.

d2_estimated_value.status: DEAD IN PRACTICE — TenderNed rarely publishes waarde; observed max 2/20 pts. Revive when leidraad document extraction can populate value.

d3_procedure_type.match_order_matters: checked in this exact order because of substring overlaps (niet-openbaar contains openbaar). Bug fixed 2026-07-21.

d4_authority_type.description: Type of contracting authority — strategic value. Extended 2026-07-21 (was: 53% of qualified fell to 'overig').
d4_authority_type.warning: Boosting buyers only pays off if the keyword filter upstream is clean — a false positive from a boosted buyer becomes Hot (seen with RIVM health tenders before the 2026-07-21 health negative keywords).

d5_deadline_urgency.description: Time from now until submission deadline — longer is better

d6_recency.description: Early detection reward — hours since publicatie_datum (fallback scraped_at). Switched from scraped_at-only 2026-07-21.

d7_cba_relationship.status: DEAD — known_buyers table does not exist yet; always 0. Revive when CBA provides a customer/prospect list.

red_flags.description: Any red flag triggers auto-downgrade by ONE label (Hot->Warm, Warm->Cold, etc.). deadline_passed -> Disqualified.

auto_disqualify.description: Handled upstream of scoring: keyword filter (negative keywords incl. health topics since 2026-07-21) DISQUALIFIES before scoring; deadline_passed disqualifies in scoring.
conditions: negative keyword hit (schoonmaak, bouw, vervoer, ..., vaccinatie, griep, prenatale, ...)
